review: Tabreez offers a great selection of fish cooked in the traditional Bahraini way. I highly recommend having it with local mashboos rice and the sauce (marag) Definitely don’t skip the sauce, as it really takes the flavors to another level. Overall, the food was absolutely delicious. They also have a nice outdoor seating area with a garden vibe, and the service was friendly and efficient. Finally, prices are very reasonable taking into consideration that it is seafood and with huge portions.

Tabreez Restaurant is widely considered one of the best spots for authentic Bahraini seafood in Manama. It offers a rustic, "no-frills" dining experience that focuses entirely on fresh, high-quality ingredients rather than fancy decor. Why Diners Love It Fresh Selection: You can personally select your fish from the daily catch. The Grilled Sea Bream and Masgoof (stuffed open-grilled fish) are highly recommended favorites. Signature Dishes: The Hamoor Machboos (spiced rice with grouper) and Fried Safi are praised for their traditional Gulf flavors. Atmosphere: While the interior is simple, the large outdoor garden seating with greenery and fountains provides a cozy, local vibe, especially during the winter months. Affordability: It is known for offering excellent value for money, with generous portions at very reasonable prices. Finishing Touch: Every meal traditionally ends with a complimentary pot of black tea brewed on charcoal, which many reviewers consider a highlight. Insider Tip: For the fastest service, it is best to visit during the week, as it can become extremely crowded on weekends

It was so delicious that we have eaten here on 3 nights so we could try different dishes. Musakhan rolls are the best. So it’s the Royal Quozi with lamp meat. And best drink ever - mint&lemon limonade! I’m definitely coming back to Bahrain just to eat here again ;-) Decorations represent the beautiful heritage of the Palestinian culture and it’s people. Staff is kind and very helpful.

A beautiful, soulful dining experience. I tried the Musakhan Fatta and the grilled chicken wings, and both were excellent. The fatta was comforting and full of flavour, with crispy bread, tender chicken, tahini, pine nuts and fresh pomegranate that added a lovely balance. The chicken wings were juicy and perfectly grilled, smoky on the outside and very satisfying. I also had the homemade lemon mint drink, which was incredibly refreshing and the perfect pairing with the food. What really made the experience special was the atmosphere. At one point, the staff came together and performed a traditional Palestinian dabke dance, holding each other by the shoulders and moving in rhythm to the music. It felt authentic, joyful, and full of heart. You could really feel the culture and pride behind the place. Great food, warm hospitality, and a genuine cultural experience. Highly recommended if you’re in Bahrain and want something memorable.

668 Cafe in Busaiteen (Al Sayh) is a trendy, contemporary spot known for its unique beverage lineup and efficient service. It has built a strong reputation in Bahrain, particularly for its "668 Signature" coffee, which many locals consider a must-try for those who enjoy sweet, flavorful drinks. Menu Highlights and Taste The cafe stands out for its creative drink menu. The 814 drink, originally famous as a hot beverage, is now widely enjoyed in its cold version featuring a unique salted caramel foam. Other popular choices include the Iced White Mocha, Matcha Berries, and various refreshing energy drinks like the Passion or Berries Energy poured over ice. For snacks, their Kinder Joy cookies and cheese croissants are frequently praised by customers for being fresh and delicious. Atmosphere and Service The Busaiteen branch is often described as having a cozy and upscale vibe, though it can get very crowded during peak weekend hours. The staff is generally recognized as professional and friendly, often managing to provide fast service even during busy periods. While the cafe offers outdoor seating and a drive-through, some customers have noted that the interior can feel a bit small for the number of visitors. Considerations One thing to keep in mind is that many of their signature drinks lean towards the sweeter side; if you prefer a less sugary taste, it is recommended to request "less sweet" when ordering. Prices typically range between BHD 1–5, which most find reasonable for the quality and brand standard. Rising through the ranks at a rapid rate, Dose Cafe is becoming one of the most prominent coffee joints in Bahrain. My first escapade into the world of Dose Cafe happened to be about a month ago, at the Zallaq branch. The cafe decor is very chic and has a certain aura to it that alleviates ones' mood. Walls are simplistic with scientific formulas all around, probably to convey the message of how "science is involved" in creating the perfect coffee. Which they do. Dose Cafe offers a wide range of products from Cappuccino, Latte, Espresso, Freez drinks to the traditional Coffee. Their best sellers include the Iced Dose Nuts & Pistachio Latte; latter of which I had ordered on our first visit along with Berry Freez. "Is it worth that hype though?" Dose has a motto that goes along the line of "Never Overdose", I suppose it rings true in a sense, because with every dose of the Iced Pistachio Latte I got evermore close to ordering it again & the sheer reality of how good this Latte really is. We all know too much of anything is bad, especially caffeine, and that's why the quantity is on the low side, however, the quality well and truly makes up for it. This drink is astounding, and to answer my question earlier... "Yes, it's worth that hype and then some". Fast forward to December and I just tried the Hot version of it, which is even better than the Iced. I know I know, all I've been talking about is the Pistachio Latte so let me delve deeper into their offerings with two other drinks - Spanish Latte & Berry Freez. The Spanish Latte is...well just like any other Spanish Latte on the Island, it really doesn't do anything special other than ticking all the boxes. Berry Freez on the other hand is delicious to the core and perfectly blended, though I believe it's not a fixed berry as we got Blueberry Freez on our first visit and Raspberry on the next, former was way better than the latter. Dose Cafe debuted in mid-2016 in Kuwait so it's still relatively young and expanding in GCC. Take your next caffeine dose at this cafe you won't regret it, but remember to never overdose. Disclaimer: Pictures are of the new branch in Adliya, Block 338. Did not snap the Zallaq branch as it was too crowded.

We had an excellent experience at Cantina Kahlo. Everything was outstanding, from the food to the atmosphere and service. The tacos, fajitas, and churros were all delicious. Specially beef tacos from the classic menu was the standout for me personally. The live entertainment added a special touch to the evening. The band was fantastic and created a lively, authentic atmosphere. One of the highlights was when the band played “Poco Loco” from the movie Coco live which caught us by surprise, which made the experience even more memorable and enjoyable. There was one small issue with our drinks. We had ordered non-alcoholic margaritas, but they were initially served with alcohol by mistake. After taking a few sips, the staff quickly realized the error, sincerely apologized, and immediately replaced the drinks. They handled the situation professionally and went above and beyond by compensating us with complimentary drinks and desserts. Mistakes can happen, and this was clearly a human error. What impressed us most was how quickly and genuinely the team took responsibility and made things right. Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience, and I would 100% recommend Cantina Kahlo. Great food, excellent live music, outstanding customer service, and a team that truly cares about its guests. Hopefully, this mix-up won’t happen again, but their response showed a high level of professionalism and hospitality.
